answers.comment: 26 = 19 Kotlin + 7 Java named subclasses. A text search finds roughly 36 declaration lines, but that includes anonymous `object : JsonAdapter<..>()` and test fixtures, which a named-class list would not hold; plausible, not exactly verified. States its limits.

findings: Medium-tier precision is poor: 25 of 30 sampled medium CALLS edges are wrong. 22 are the right method name bound to the wrong overload (jsonAdapter.fromJson(String) -> fromJson(JsonReader); jsonAdapter.toJson(value) -> toJson(JsonWriter, value); moshi.adapter<T>() -> adapter(Type) instead of the reified overload), 3 are library calls bound to repo symbols (stdlib require() -> JsonValueReader.require x2; KotlinPoet FunSpec.Builder.build() -> Moshi.Builder.build).

All overloads of a Kotlin method have param_count 0, so overloads are indistinguishable; the same wrong-overload pattern appears in the low tier (Moshi.adapter, JsonAdapter.toJson, Builder.addLast self-bound).

Kotlin stdlib/own-class names bound to Java test classes: Pair(...) in ksp/shadedUtil.kt bound to moshi/src/test/java/android/util/Pair.java (low, x2 in the sample), and Node() in LinkedHashTreeMap.kt bound to the Java test class CircularAdaptersTest.Node instead of the nested LinkedHashTreeMap.Node in the same file.
Nested class constructor calls in the same file are not resolved: KeySet() and EntrySet() in LinkedHashTreeMap.kt are unresolved although both are declared in that file.
Calls inside initialisers of top-level properties produce no edges: references resolve (to knownNotNull) but the caller is not a symbol; 8 of 40 recall sites in Util.kt were lost this way.
Top-level val/const declarations are not extracted (9 in the five files; roughly 34 companion consts in -JsonUtf8Reader.kt, not counted).
Protected methods inherited from a superclass in another file (pushScope) are unresolved in the subclass (-JsonUtf8Reader.kt:62, :83).
Methods of a class named with backticks (`-JsonUtf8Reader`) get an fqn with no class qualifier, so 40 methods look like top-level functions.
Methods of anonymous object literals are extracted as functions named <locals>.next / renderTypeVariable (3 spurious in the sample).
A class extending another class via secondary constructors (`class -JsonUtf8Reader : JsonReader`) is recorded as IMPLEMENTS rather than EXTENDS.
Two real Kotlin sources parse with syntax errors: PropertyGenerator.kt (4 error nodes, first at line 25) and KspUtil.kt (line 141); both are only flagged partial.

Positive: definitions for the five largest files were 201 of 210 with no missed functions or classes; high-tier call precision was 29/30; hierarchy edges were 20/20 right and 8/8 relationships in the checked files; find_callers admits its unresolved reference.
not_done: Java files in the repository were not measured (out of scope).
